title: AI Fairness Beyond Complete Demographics: Current Achievements and Future Directions
reasoning: The paper is a comprehensive survey of AI fairness, focusing on settings with incomplete demographic information. It categorizes 'Rawlsian Fairness' (Section 3.1), a fundamental ethical framework based on distributive justice, as one of its primary taxonomies. It also identifies religious affiliation as a protected demographic attribute in its summary of benchmark datasets (Section 5) and discuss the ethical challenges of discriminatory outcomes in AI.
